title: Men's Christmas – Mom's Favorite Tee
hook: MOM'S FAVORITE. Check the stockings. This funny Mom's favorite shirt is for the brother who says it with a straight face at Christmas dinner, with the evidence hanging right there: one stocking stuffed with presents, candy canes and a toy truck, the other with a single candy cane. It is a good Christmas gift for a brother, and the sibling who has to look at it all day will get the point.
art: The print is a 1960s storybook mantel in faded red, pine green, mustard and cream: a brick fireplace with a pine garland and two knit stockings, the left one overflowing with wrapped presents, candy canes, ornaments and a toy truck, the right one limp with one candy cane poking out. MOM'S FAVORITE. runs across the top in red slab capitals and Check the stockings. sits below in black script.
wear: Wear it to Christmas dinner, the stocking-stuffing hour or any family gathering where the favorite-child bit is still running, or give it to the brother who always claims the title.
qa: What is the Mom's Favorite tee?

It is a men's Christmas graphic tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing two knit stockings on a brick mantel, one stuffed with gifts and one nearly empty, lettered MOM'S FAVORITE. Check the stockings. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 3001 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light at a crowded Christmas dinner.
How does the unisex tee fit?

This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 4XL with a crew neck and side-seamed body. Order your usual size for a regular fit or size up one for a looser look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free within 30 days.
How do I wash it so the print lasts?

Wash your Mom's Favorite tee inside out in cold water and tumble dry low. It is 100% combed ring-spun cotton at 4.2 oz, with some polyester in the heather colors, and the red, green and mustard inks stay crisp through every Christmas dinner and wash.
Is it a good gift for a brother?

Yes. A sister, a mom or a parent can order it for the brother who claims the favorite spot, and he can order it himself to annoy everyone. It is $24.99 from Graphic Tees Co. in six colors, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Mom's Favorite tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
